description: On Tuesday the 9th I got up early and headed to Lexington to attend the 2025 KVH Conference. This was powerful. It should have been PACKED with those serving as our legislators. They need to know this information from non-partisan professionals. There was no sugar coating of the problem we are in. K
title: Notes from the 2015 Kentucky Voices for Health Conference, dec 2025 — The 10th District Project
